Compare the\0A// Compiler Explorer options field for the DXC pane: no such option as\0A// `-keep-all-resources` or `-fhlsl-unused-resource-bindings=reserve-all`\0A// (both proposed in still-open, unmerged PRs #7643/#7734) is available here.\0A//==========================================================================//\0A\0A// #5105: an unused, explicitly-registered resource should remain visible in\0A// reflection/disassembly even though nothing in the entry point references it.\0A//\0A// unusedTex (t1) is declared but never read. usedTex (t0) and samp (s0) are\0A// both read, so they must survive under any configuration; unusedTex is the\0A// resource under test.\0ATexture2D<float4> usedTex : register(t0);\0ATexture2D<float4> unusedTex : register(t1);\0ASamplerState samp : register(s0);\0A\0Afloat4 main(float2 uv : TEXCOORD) : SV_Target\0A{\0A    return usedTex.Sample(samp, uv);\0A}\0A"}
